planets.name: WASP-62 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Naledi with a 4.41-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-62 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Naledi. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2012, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.41193868, pl_radj 1.32, pl_bmassj 0.52

quotes.title: WASP-62
quotes.card: It is an F-class main-sequence star, orbited by a planet, WASP-62b.
quotes.introduction: The age of WASP-62 is much younger than the Sun at 0.8±0.6 billion years, and it has a metal abundance similar to the Sun.
